description: Create a new NFT asset from a local file or base64 data

contractId.description: ID of the collection to mint the asset in

editions.description: Number of editions (for ERC1155 collections only, 1-1000)

fileData.description: Base64 encoded file data (for Claude Desktop)

filePath.description: Absolute path to the media file (for local files)

location.description: Location where the asset was created (optional, max 100 characters)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (required when using fileData, e.g., 'image/png')

shareWithCommunity.description: Make the asset discoverable by the community (optional, default: false)

name: create_asset
